records.text: Hillary Clinton sought the location of Gilgamesh's tomb a few days before the United States invaded Iraq.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Do you guys ever wonder why Hillary Clinton in those WikiLeak emails was asking a few days before we invaded Iraq, she was trying to locate Gilgamesh's tomb.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. The email about locating Gilgamesh's tomb was a 2018 Freedom of Information Act request sent to the State Department by requester Denetra Senigar; it was not a directive or search request from Hillary Clinton. It also came fifteen years after the 2003 invasion of Iraq, not shortly before it.

sources.title: Lead Stories: Hillary Clinton and the Gilgamesh FOIA email
sources.relevance: Identifies the document as a private citizen's 2018 FOIA request and directly contradicts both the attribution to Clinton and the pre-invasion timing.
